## Overview

The Order of the Dawn is the church of the **God of Light and Life** — the most beloved and trusted deity of the pantheon. The Order tends to the sick, protects the vulnerable, and stands against the darkness of the monster threat.

## Structure

The Order of the Dawn is organized around temples in all three capitals, with smaller shrines throughout the recovered territories. Its clergy include healers, midwives, and protectors who serve their communities selflessly.

## Membership

The Order welcomes all who wish to serve Light and Life. Its members include:
- **Priests and Priestesses**: Clerics who perform healing, blessings, and daily worship
- **Paladins**: Holy warriors who defend the faithful and fight monsters
- **Lay Brothers and Sisters**: Non-clerical members who tend to the sick, run hospices, and maintain temples
- **Healers**: Medical practitioners who serve both the military and civilian populations

## Goals

- Spread healing and compassion throughout the mortal races
- Protect the faithful from monsters and darkness
- Maintain the worship of the God of Light and Life
- Support the reconquering through healing and spiritual guidance

## Headquarters

The Order's main temple is located in **Weaveheart**, with major chapter houses in Skywatch and Emberforge.
